scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The statement treats precisely the threefold quotient of consecutive generators 3k+1 and 3k+2 for every integer k>=2; it does not classify general quotients or general three-generator semigroups. Its universal proof uses exact Apéry representatives and a finite residue analysis, not extrapolated computations. Independent scientific validation has not occurred. Some potentially relevant older full text was inaccessible, so equivalence in unindexed work is a residual priority risk.
title: Complete isolated-gap classification for a threefold quotient of consecutive-generator semigroups
